summary: Centered hero after Firstsource: a large headline whose *accent* part sits on a solid brand-colour block, a short centered lead and one or two buttons, then a row of 3 or 4 tall photo cards that link into the page (a service line, a case study, careers, a report). Each card has a real photo, a small tag and a title on a dark shade, and a round arrow. Suits enterprise and multi-service BPOs with several things worth a click; every card href must point at a real section or page, never at a placeholder.
